module: Flowgraph node "Decal Line" (category repeat_instant, util/draw). Draws a line of decals from point posA to point posB, like a loading bar. Input pins: posA, posB, decalScale, amount (32), inverted, decalPath, filling1, filling2 (0 to 100), and four colors (filledColor, fillingColor1, fillingColor2, backgroundColor). Submits the decals to Engine.Render.DynamicDecalMgr.addDecals.
notes: data.snapToTerrain = false is defined but unused in this file.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the decal pool and the color caches.

work.desc: Places the decals by interpolation between posA and posB, chooses their color according to filling1/filling2 and submits them to the renderer.
